system.description:
Use this skill when you make an [Evasion Check] against an attack from outside of close range. Add +2 to the result of the check. No effect can reduce the result of this check or the number of dice rolled for it.

(Hate Top): You may also use this skill making a [Resistance Check].

A skill that blocks incoming arrows by holding a shield in front of the body. If it attacks from the front, it is possible to repel even magic.
